exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_source_note: Counts are across all 205 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (lifetime source attribution as recorded on each opportunity), not just today's window.
reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 205 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime, not the STORE pipeline). A contact can carry more than one lead: tag at once (see Ariel Aradanas, hot+unqualified), so tag counts don't sum exactly to 205 minus untagged.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Far Out (Cold) and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by the same Oct-2025 bulk-import batch (97 of 122 Far Out records) and a couple of 200+ day Postponed records flagged in workflow_drift. Continues the trend documented on 08-14 (255.2 avg then, 262.1 now — same frozen batch aging in place).
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a daily metric). Continues the documented growth from the 08-14 run (265/304/226/1225 then).
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline: 51 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (66 total, lifetime). Retail material sales, distinct from project work. No stale thresholds defined for it (its own +3d/+8d automated cadence). No STORE pipeline activity in today's 24h window.

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.
meeting_window_summary.note: 15 of 23 Meeting-Scheduled contacts had a verifiable appointment date this run (via calendar events, wide window pull). 2 (Basil Da Souza, Silviya Jardany) already show effective_window_days <= 0 — appointment booked so far out that stale_lead fires before any follow-up sequence could run. Full detail in workflow_drift and conversations.

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Scoped this run to today's active conversations' mobile-quote-tagged contacts (15 checked): 1 violation found (Albert Ngo, contact — see drift). A full account-wide sweep of all historical mobile-quote contacts was not attempted (same scoping limitation noted in the 08-14 run).

drift_findings_breakdown._comment: metrics.drift_findings is the sum of underlying affected records per category (after excluded-stage suppression), not the count of report lines in workflow_drift (which aggregates large groups into single lines for readability).

reporting.resolved_since_last_report: Of the 5 abandonment_next opportunities flagged overdue on 08-14 (Lena Navsarikar, Giovanni Zapata, Leanna Knight, Ghandi, Zinat Hirji), 3 (Lena Navsarikar, Giovanni Zapata, Leanna Knight) no longer appear in the open-and-overdue set — presumed resolved (abandoned or worked) between 08-14 and today. reporting.platform_note_continuation: The undocumented 'abandoned-stale' tag (first surfaced 08-14 on Bash Saqr, Tina Tran, Anujan Kumaranathan) is still present on those same 3 open opportunities today, now 106.6-190 days into their stage with no resolution — still worth Albert's decision on whether it's a real automation output or a stray manual tag.
reporting.ingest_gap_note: The last successful ghl-ingest run before this one was 2026-08-14 (a 9-day gap: 08-15 through 08-22 were not ingested). Per instructions this run used the standard 24h window (2026-08-22T08:22 to 2026-08-23T08:22 America/Toronto) rather than backfilling the gap; activity from 08-15 through 08-21 is not reflected in this file's items/metrics, though some surfaces indirectly in days_in_stage and the resolved_since_last_report note above.
